public.title: Minimum Knight Moves
public.description: On an unbounded chessboard, a knight starts at [0,0]. Each move changes one coordinate by 2 and the other by 1, in either sign. Return the fewest moves to [x,y]. Both coordinates are integers from -50 through 50.
hints: Use board symmetry and breadth-first search, keeping a small margin around the target.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Reflection puts the target in the first quadrant. Shortest routes can be searched inside the rectangle enlarged by two cells on every side. BFS returns minimum move count.
